evidence_policy.rule: IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED; VERIFIED requires acceptance criteria evidenced against the exact source SHA and required gates.
evidence_policy.merge_policy: Never auto-merge; preserve required gates and branch protections.

documentation_index.title: Architecture and system boundaries
acceptance_criteria: SSOT ownership and layer boundaries documented
Cross-repository conflicts linked to evidence

documentation_index.title: Control plane and status model
acceptance_criteria: Statuses distinguish implementation from verification
Evidence points to exact commits and gate runs

documentation_index.title: Machine-readable delivery registry and roadmap
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap, milestones, checkpoints, components, functions, sprints and TODOs have stable IDs
Updates derive from GitHub/CI evidence

roadmap.title: Governance and evidence control plane
acceptance_criteria: Registry and status schema consistent
Exact-SHA evidence audit trail exists

roadmap.title: ShivaCore development-kernel hardening
acceptance_criteria: VMM mapping mutation and lifetime invariants tested
Rust/test/UEFI secure boot/ACPI evidence recorded

roadmap.title: A-TownChain protocol and consensus readiness
acceptance_criteria: Protocol economics and TX-v2 vectors agree across canonical implementation and specs
Consensus choice not represented as final until formally decided

roadmap.title: ATC-VM and ATCLang deterministic toolchain
acceptance_criteria: Bytecode format, resource limits and malformed-input rejection tested
Canonical VM ownership remains in a-townchain/components/vm

roadmap.title: Aurora AI and Genesis integration boundaries
acceptance_criteria: AI authority remains outside ShivaCore TCB and consensus
Intent-policy-capability-approval-tool-service boundary documented

milestones.title: Evidence-driven governance baseline
acceptance_criteria: Status schema published
Open failures have exact SHA/run/job/step/log/root cause/fix/retest fields
No gate weakening or automatic merge

milestones.title: ShivaCore kernel safety gates
acceptance_criteria: VMM mutation/rollback and mapping lifetime tests pass
Required Rust, boot, UEFI/ACPI evidence available at exact SHA

milestones.title: A-TownChain protocol conformance
acceptance_criteria: Consensus decision explicitly recorded
TX-v2 vectors and encoding specs match canonical code
Supply/decimals/counters and chain ID are consistent

milestones.title: ATCLang/ATC-VM toolchain conformance
acceptance_criteria: ATCB format and limits are unambiguous
Malformed bytecode and resource exhaustion tests pass

milestones.title: Aurora/Genesis ecosystem integration
acceptance_criteria: Integration contracts and service boundaries reviewed
No duplicate canonical implementations introduced

checkpoints.title: Exact-SHA gate verification
acceptance_criteria: Every required run resolves to the same tested commit SHA
Run/job/step outcomes and logs are retained
No pending required gate is treated as green

checkpoints.title: Canonical ownership conflict scan
acceptance_criteria: Every component has one canonical implementation owner
Specs/support repos are not silently treated as implementation owners

checkpoints.title: ShivaCore kernel readiness
acceptance_criteria: VMM and object lifetime criteria pass
Required boot/security evidence recorded
evidence_refs: Known context: globus-os main SHA 41ba1004... previously classified IMPLEMENTED/BLOCKED — Development Kernel; refresh exact SHA before relying on this

checkpoints.title: globus-os PR #48 CI completion
acceptance_criteria: All required gates pass at current PR head SHA
ATC evidence artifact satisfies governance semantics, not merely upload success

components.name: atc-engineering
components.role: engineering governance, evidence and CI policy

components.name: a-townchain-ecosystem
components.role: integration/compliance/evidence/architecture control plane; not canonical VM/algorithm implementation

components.name: ShivaCore Kernel
components.role: no_std capability microkernel and security boundary

components.name: Aurora AI
components.role: AI runtime/assistant; outside kernel TCB and consensus authority

components.name: ATC-Algorithm
components.role: canonical consensus/algorithm implementation; protocol decision status must be explicit

components.name: Genesis Engine
components.role: genesis/bootstrap orchestration; implementation status to be audited

functions.title: Gate discovery and root-cause repair
acceptance_criteria: Failures tied to exact SHA/run/job/step
Fixes preserve all gates

functions.title: Evidence lifecycle and verification
acceptance_criteria: REGISTERED→RUNNING→ANALYZED→VERIFIED lifecycle supported
Failures become FAILED/BLOCKED; verified items may be reopened as RESIDUAL

functions.title: Capability security and process/resource isolation
acceptance_criteria: No ambient authority
Capability checks enforced at kernel boundary
Required isolation tests pass

functions.title: Virtual memory mapping mutation and lifetime
acceptance_criteria: Mutation rollback and bottom-up table cleanup tested
Mapping/object lifetimes prevent stale references

functions.title: TX-V2 deterministic signing and encoding
acceptance_criteria: secp256k1 ECDSA RFC6979/SHA-256, low-S and compressed SEC1 key vectors pass
Legacy domains and Ed25519 transaction signing rejected

functions.title: ATCB validation, execution limits and gas
acceptance_criteria: ATCB magic/version/count parsed deterministically
Program/stack/storage limits and malformed-bytecode rejection tested

functions.title: Aurora intent-policy-capability-approved tool execution
acceptance_criteria: Proposal→Policy→Capability Check→Approval→Tool→Service Boundary→Authoritative Runtime
Aurora is not kernel TCB, consensus or chain authority

functions.title: Cross-repository integration and conformance
acceptance_criteria: Contracts and canonical owners mapped
No duplicate production implementations

sprints.title: Gate closure and evidence integrity
sprints.timebox: Not date-boxed; schedule to be confirmed from repository issue/milestone data
goals: Resolve red required gates across active repos
Close residual evidence semantics for globus-os PR #48

sprints.title: SSOT and architecture inventory reconciliation
goals: Audit all active repos/components against SSOT map
Reconcile roadmap statuses with actual CI and open PRs

todos.title: Scan and fix failed required gates across all reachable active repositories
acceptance_criteria: Current failed runs triaged
Root cause and retest logged against exact SHA

todos.title: Validate evidence lifecycle and artifact semantics
acceptance_criteria: Artifact availability not conflated with governance compliance
Evidence is discoverable and bound to tested SHA/run

todos.title: Finish globus-os PR #48 gate verification
acceptance_criteria: Refresh current PR head
All required checks terminal and green
Confirm evidence artifact semantics
Leave PR unmerged until authorized and gates pass

todos.title: Reconcile all active repositories, canonical component owners and migration residuals
acceptance_criteria: Repo census current
No duplicate SSOT ownership
Migration inventory agrees with main branch evidence

todos.title: Maintain wiki/documentation index and repo-local documentation links
acceptance_criteria: Every component has authoritative docs link or explicit gap
GitHub Wiki disabled is noted; versioned docs serve as wiki index

todos.title: Reverify VMM M1.2/M1.3 and boot/security gates at current globus-os SHA
acceptance_criteria: Page-table mutation rollback verified
Mapping/object lifetime verified
Rust, UEFI Secure Boot and ACPI evidence available

todos.title: Reconcile chain economics, TX-V2 vectors and consensus decision across code/specs
acceptance_criteria: Canonical parameters agree across repositories
Unfinalized consensus options remain explicitly unfinalized

todos.title: Complete per-repository documentation and delivery-plan audit for all 33 visible repositories
acceptance_criteria: All 33 repositories appear in repository_inventory with active/archive state and audit status
Each repository has a repository_delivery_plans record covering documentation, roadmap, milestones, checkpoints, components, functions, sprints and TODOs
Loop inspects repository default-branch SHA, docs, open PRs and required CI; it records exact evidence and updates each plan
Unknown or inaccessible data remains RESIDUAL/BLOCKED; no repository is marked VERIFIED merely because it exists
